## CalendarClient interface

The Calendar client: one namespace per resource that has operations, plus the app's own commands. A client factory creates one from `calendarContract` in the app's `/contract` entry. Its type carries the contract's resource table, [CalendarResources](./calendar_contract.calendarresources.md)<!-- -->, so references can be bound to it by resource; the brand has no runtime member.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface CalendarClient extends ClientBrand<CalendarResources>
```

**Extends:** [ClientBrand](./contracts.clientbrand.md)<!-- -->&lt;[CalendarResources](./calendar_contract.calendarresources.md)<!-- -->&gt;
